Landed at commit 8f0c05c2588c60de79e77604bfe08fa543497179 (modules/fit/shared). BasisExpandedRetention.prepare admits the same shared-OLS route as FirstLevelEstimates (typed refusals for other engines, missing-data policies and temporal weighting), realizes the design for the selected timepoints, splits it by a caller-declared condition-major TaskBasisStructure, and partials all remaining columns out of both sides (FWL) once at preparation - no response reads. foreachBlock streams complete per-block BasisExpandedFitProducts through the shared EstimateBlockExecutor (bounded reads, cancellation before read and delivery); retainAll assembles the full selected voxel axis and refuses to publish a partial product on cancellation.

Semantics refinement to the kernel from bd-01M23D69QKPCGN65KZJD06E74S: BasisExpandedFitProduct now retains rows + nonTaskRank instead of caller-supplied residualDf, and reprojection uses the collapsed refit's own df (rows - nonTaskRank - conditions). SE/t maps are therefore exactly the refit's values, not approximations with borrowed df.

Evidence: BasisExpandedRetentionSuite (5 tests) verifies preparation reads nothing, the executor-retained product reprojects to a literal collapsed-design OLS refit (test-local Gaussian elimination, time-domain residuals) at 1e-9 including SEs and c'M^-1c, blockwise/assembled panel equality, typed refusals (ragged/duplicate/unknown structure, runwise engine), and cancellation semantics. fitJVM 296/296, fitJS 287/287.

Remaining scope intentionally out: GLS/whitened engines and per-run cross-products (runwise partitioning) - lodge separately if the explorer adopts run-level dispersion; plsneuro C3 still owns the real-subject verification leg.
